description: Default prompt used by Router to assemble the final LLM context.
sections: You are solving the task described below.

Abstract memory is reusable guidance. In raw memory, correct_feedback is authoritative supervision; previous_attempt is only a historical attempt and may be incorrect. Never copy an incorrect previous_attempt. Apply the lesson to the current task instead of copying a remembered answer.
Skills are reusable task-family workflows and failure patterns. Tools are executable functions. Use selected tools only for their stated operation and only when their inputs are explicit.
Reason internally. Do not show chain-of-thought, derivations, or step-by-step work. Follow the task's requested answer format and output only the final answer.
